m.s: Cut {pork_shoulder} into 3cm cubes. Toss with {oregano}, the juice of {lemon*0.5}, {garlic*0.5} (crushed), a glug of oil and 1 tsp salt. Leave for 20 minutes, then thread onto skewers if you have them.
Heat the oven to 220°C. Cut {potato} into wedges, toss with a good drizzle of oil and a pinch of salt on a lined tray, and roast for 35 to 40 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and crisp.

Coarsely grate {cucumber*0.5}, then squeeze out as much water as you can with your hands so it doesn't go runny. Stir into {yoghurt} with the rest of the garlic, chopped {mint}, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.
Chop the rest of the cucumber, {cherrytom} and {red_onion}. Crumble over {fetta} and dress with a drizzle of oil, a squeeze of lemon and a pinch of salt.

Heat a grill pan, BBQ or frying pan over medium-high heat. Cook the pork for 8 to 10 minutes, turning every couple of minutes, until charred on the edges and cooked through with no pink in the middle.
Warm {pita} in the oven for the last 2 minutes of the chips. Let everyone build their own with pork, salad, tzatziki and a few chips tucked in.

l: Pack the pork, salad and tzatziki separately. Skip the chips and double the salad. Keeps 3 days in the fridge.
g: GF wraps instead of pita. Everything else is naturally gluten free.
